timing_scope.streamed: Sample host timer covers preprocessing, H2D transfer, GPU pricing, D2H transfer and event waits. Allocation/RNG initialization occur before timing; CPU finalization and Black-Scholes validation occur after. Exclude compilation.
timing_scope.threaded: Each GPU host timer starts before initMonteCarloGPU, includes allocation/RNG initialization, pricing and cudaDeviceSynchronize, and stops before closeMonteCarloGPU. One GPU yields one Total time value.
timing_scope.trusted_wall: Elapsed seconds of full invocation; distinct from sample mc_ms.
